text:
Maria Lopez: Drafting the v0.11 release notes now — aiming for a concise whats-new and a small known-issues section. Pushed a docs PR with placeholders for migration snippets and the SDK examples. Can reviewers scan links?

Devon Chen: On it. Quick question — do we want the Python SDK example to show the new client.responses API or stick with the shim for backward compat?

Maria Lopez: Prefer explicit new API so it's clear for new users. Add a short note about the shim in a separate callout.

Devon Chen: Ack. Placeholder snippet added: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=ENV['RW_KEY'])
resp = client.responses.create(prompt='hello')
print(resp.output_text)
```

docs-bot: linkcheck: found 2 redirects and 1 broken link in PR #4521 (/sdk/python -> /sdk/python/overview, /old-embed-guide -> redirected).

Sahil Rao: I'll open a tiny redirect PR for /old-embed-guide -> /embed-guides and chase the SDK anchor. Also flagging a known issue: in Dedicated low-latency mode, token-streams may duplicate when network hiccups. Needs a short mitigation note.

Emily Park: I'll draft the mitigation blurb: "If you see duplicate tokens during streaming, retry idempotently or fall back to non-streaming mode; we're rolling a fix in next runtime patch." Keep it terse.

Ben Ortiz: Copy nit: in the whats-new header we say "throughput improvements" — can we be more specific: "throughput and cost improvements for batching"? makes the benefit clearer.

Maria Lopez: Good call, Ben. I'll update the header and the TL;DR bullets to mention cost impact estimates (10-25% depending on workload).

Devon Chen: Found a small typo in the migration guide: "kv-cache" -> "KV cache". Pushing a one-line fix.

Maria Lopez: Thanks. Plan: merge PR after linkcheck and one round of copyedit. Target merge time 18:30 UTC today unless new blockers.

Devon Chen: LGTM after my tiny typo fix — will approve in a few.

Sahil Rao: Redirect PR opened: #4523. Added a test for the anchor resolve.

Emily Park: Final pass done — condensed some bullets and added the mitigation phrasing.

Maria Lopez: Merging now. Will post the whats-new page once CI finishes. Thanks everyone! :tada:

docs-bot: CI: docs build succeeded for main at 2419200280. Release notes published to staging.

Maria Lopez: Published to prod: https://docs.redwood.com/whats-new/v0.11 — double-check links and ping if anything looks off.

Ben Ortiz: Checked basic flow, all links resolve. Nice work.

Devon Chen: Verified SDK snippets render and code block highlights okay.

Sahil Rao: Monitoring linkwatch; will report if crawler finds anything overnight.

Maria Lopez: Closing thread — will open a follow-up if any post-publish issues surface.
